temporary_install_canary_exception.rule: No runnable project snapshots, including temporary test or canary copies.
temporary_install_canary_exception.protected_property: One authoritative ArtVault source checkout; no duplicate source ownership or divergence.
temporary_install_canary_exception.necessity: Static archive inspection does not prove installation. The existing test environment contains an older candidate. A prior zipimport attempt resolved the older installed package instead of the wheel, so it was not accepted as install evidence.
alternative_rejected: Overwrite the existing test environment containing the older package.
Treat zipimport or metadata inspection as an installation canary.

operations: verify installed distribution metadata and imported module location

compensating_controls: Target must be absent before creation.
Use only the SHA-256 verified wheel; install no dependencies and access no network.
Use no project checkout, target repository, private corpus, credentials, or Git metadata.
The registered ArtVault canon remains the sole source and writer.
Remove only this exact target after capturing test output; preserve all other temporary and untracked data.
Stop and record failure if any control or hash check fails.
temporary_install_canary_exception.retirement: Remove exactly /tmp/giga-archaeology-canary-final-0.1.3b4 after the one-shot check; preserve all other files.

evidence_corrections.reason: Those statements conflict with each other and with the observed earlier zipimport attempt, which resolved an existing 0.1.3b3 installation and was not valid b4 installation evidence. The later, separately recorded final-wheel pip canary is valid limited evidence.
evidence_corrections.authority: Correction preserves the rejection and distinguishes it from the successful final-wheel canary.

donor_review.inspection: Read directly from the retained historical Git object into memory; no extraction or execution. Runtime API and test inventories reviewed, with focused inspection of policy-root validation, authority admission, candidate attestation, bounded local checks and secret-path scanning.
donor_review.feature_classification: The bundle implements GIGA Control machine-policy and development-authority gates, local sandboxed verification, candidate commit/evidence attestation, and fixed-pattern secret scanning. These belong to agent governance. Archaeology already has privacy-filtered inventory, source hashing, evidence seals, quarantine and release packaging. Importing a second authority/admission runtime would add a competing responsibility rather than an Archaeology feature.
donor_review.disposition: No transplant. Preserve the historical donor object and its Git dependencies; no GitHub restoration or new copy was used.

clean_dependency_install_canary.scope: Resolve and install the final wheel with its declared runtime dependencies in a fresh Python 3.12.3 virtual environment; no repository checkout, Git data, or private corpus was copied.
clean_dependency_install_canary.installed_console_entrypoint_help: PASS from outside the source repository.
clean_dependency_install_canary.first_import_attempt: REJECTED: launched from the canon working directory, so Python selected the source-tree module; rerun from /tmp imported from the installed environment and passed.
clean_dependency_install_canary.network: Used the configured package index to resolve pinned runtime dependencies; no repository source, private corpus, or Git metadata was uploaded. Configured index authentication was not audited.
clean_dependency_install_canary.retirement_verification: Only the exact task-created environment was removed; path confirmed absent.
clean_dependency_install_canary.exception_controls: Recorded before install in the active task: exact wheel SHA only; exact target confirmed absent; --no-cache-dir; no repository checkout, Git data, private corpus, or alternate source; exact-target cleanup and absence verification.

macos_install_canary.installed_console_entrypoint_help: PASS from outside the source repository.
macos_install_canary.failed_attempt_preserved: pip initially rejected the transferred temporary filename as an invalid wheel filename before package installation. After renaming the same SHA-verified bytes to the canonical wheel filename, dependency resolution and installation passed.
macos_install_canary.network: Configured package index supplied platform wheels for the pinned dependencies; no repository source, private corpus, or Git metadata was uploaded. Configured index authentication was not audited.
macos_install_canary.retirement_verification: Both exact wheel paths and the exact temporary environment were confirmed absent after the canary.
